text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: service/api-gateway v2.1.0 -> canary 5% at 15:00 UTC. changelog: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/api-gateway-2.1.0 :rocket:
Alex: FYI I pushed the canary config and pinned the traffic split. Monitoring hooks live.
Maria: Copy. Can we quick-validate the backout runbook before we go wider? Link?
Alex: Runbook here: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/backout-api-gateway-2026 (steps + rollback CLI). TL;DR: 1) pin traffic to v2.0.9 2) scale down canary pods 3) clear cache entries.
Kevin: I skimmed it. Need exact commands for ops to run. Adding them inline now.
Kevin: Rollback commands: ``kubectl -n prod set image deploy/api-gateway api-gateway=redwood/api-gateway:v2.0.9 && kubectl rollout status deploy/api-gateway -n prod`` then ``/scripts/clear-kv-cache --service api-gateway``.
Oncall-ops: Noted. We'll stage these on the ops jumpbox and create a short alias `rb-agw` to avoid typos.
Sara: What are the SLO thresholds to trigger immediate backout for this canary?
Maria: Agreed thresholds: error-rate > 2% across endpoints OR p95 latency degradation > 200ms compared to baseline (last 1h). Also any client-facing 5xx spike >= 10 errors/minute for 5 consecutive mins.
Alex: Also note dependency check: if upstream auth service shows errors > 1%, we hold and escalate; do not rollback immediately unless our error-rate rises.
Kevin: I'll be oncall for the next hour. @sara you good to be backup?
Sara: Yes, I'll cover. If we hit thresholds I'll run the alias and post output here.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% at 15:05 UTC. Health checks passing (10m window). Metrics: p95=120ms, error-rate=0.2%.
Maria: :eyes: let's hold for 20m then bump to 25% if stable.
Alex: Reminder: if we decide to pin instead of rollback, use traffic-pin: ``curl -X POST https://deploy-api.internal/pin -d '{"service":"api-gateway","version":"v2.0.9"}'`` This forces routing layer to v2.0.9 while we investigate.
Oncall-ops: Creating a pinned route alias now so rollback is atomic.
Kevin: 15:25 UTC - observed small spike on /v1/search: p95 jumped to 220ms, error-rate still 0.5%. I'm watching.
Sara: I see traces indicating a DB connection pool warmup issue for a subset of pods. Not widespread.
Maria: Hold on further. We'll let canary finish 30m then make decision. If p95 persists >200ms at 15:45, prepare to execute rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 25% at 15:35 UTC. Health summary: p95=140ms, error-rate=0.4%.
Kevin: 15:42 UTC - p95 for /v1/search stabilized back to 160ms. Accepting current state. No rollback.
Alex: Good catch team. Post-mortem item: add a quick DB pool warmup hook to the readiness probe. I will open a ticket.
Maria: Filing a release note addendum and updating runbook with the alias command and the DB warmup checklist.
Sara: Closing watch, I'll handover to next oncall at 16:00. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
